name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Holloway goes with Gardener, or Pierce goes with Cooking — but not both.
Gardener does not go with Reading.
Blackwood goes with at least one of Butler, Gardener, or Cooking.
Between Governess and Valet, one goes with Holloway and the other with Walking.
Either Walking goes with Valet or Pierce goes with Butler.
Ashford goes with none of Butler, Painting, or Walking.
Between Chef and Valet, one goes with Holloway and the other with Writing.
